publications.title: The LEGO Group to build new factory in Estarreja, Portugal
publications.summary: Sites November 22, 2026 The LEGO Group to build new factory in Estarreja, Portugal The LEGO Group today announced it will build a new factory in Estarreja, Portugal. The 115,000 m2 facility is expected to open in 2030 and will support end-to-end LEGO® production, including moulding, processing and packing. It will expand the company’s manufacturing capacity, helping to support growing demand for LEGO products across Europe, Middle East and Africa.

publications.title: The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature
publications.summary: Responsibility October 27, 2026 The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature The LEGO Group and Sesame Workshop, the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street, have launched three new videos, funded by the LEGO Foundation, encouraging children aged 4 to 6 to discover the natural world through play. Featuring Elmo, Cookie Monster and other Sesame Street friends, the videos introduce children to bats, butterflies and worms before inviting them to build habitats using LEGO bricks and everyday craft materials. The LEGO Group’s free activity guides and printables help families and educators extend the experience through hands-on play at home and in community settings.

publications.title: Review: 67009 Arkham Batman Batmobile
publications.summary: LEGO DC Super Heroes features no shortage of Batmobile sets, but there are still many notable models yet to appear. The tank-like vehicle from Batman: Arkham Knight certainly feels overdue, hence the high expectations for 67009 Arkham Batman Batmobile. However, this Batmobile is very complex in the video game, switching from a streamlined car to a tank with weaponry and caster wheels. I would not realistically expect a minifigure-scale model to capture those functions, though this vehicle risks looking incomplete without them. On the other hand, the set does offer an unexpected feature not shown in official images. Continue reading » © 2026 Brickset.com . Republication prohibited without prior permission.

publications.title: Review: 75480 Duel on Bespin
publications.summary: 75480 Duel on Bespin takes inspiration from the famous lightsaber duel between Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader during The Empire Strikes Back, concluding with an iconic moment in the history of cinema. This scene definitely deserves a place in the 50th anniversary range. Moreover, I think this rendition of the lightsaber duel looks excellent. There are similarities between this model and 75294 Bespin Duel, sold briefly in the US in 2020, but the new design includes more of the sensor balcony where the duel ends and generally seems more refined. It also offers a fantastic concept art minifigure: Darth Vader. Continue reading » © 2026 Brickset.com . Republication prohibited without prior permission.

publications.summary: The classic BTL-A4 Y-wing Starfighter has been available multiple times in the LEGO Star Wars range, although not for a decade at minifigure-scale, since 75172 Y-wing Starfighter arrived in early 2017. We are certainly due for an updated rendition of the Rebel fighter-bomber. 75478 Rebel Y-wing Starfighter obliges and the model looks amazing, not least because of its new dual-moulded canopy, finally replacing the element from 1999.
